pairs._source: plan rev3 A1, our choice: per KB 12 out-of-scope sites, 4 from each KB tag-distance rank stratum (near 1-6, middle 7-30, far 31-85 (86 sites after excluding rus)); ranks instead of thresholds because tag-JS saturates (P19) | A16: strata rescaled to the site count (see _a16_source)

comparison.fixed_rule: far band (d > q_far) to both O and KB, category != category(O)
comparison._source: plan rev3 A1: m = 4, R = 5; slot roles O (leak), N1/N2 (two nearest eligible to O outside KB's neighbour band), M (median rank to O), Z1/Z2 (random, far band to both), Zm (sensitivity, user decision 2026-10-06: far band to O, KB-distance rank closest to N1's), K (nearest eligible to KB outside O's neighbour band and not N1/N2), NK (min rank_O + rank_KB among eligible not already used). Eligible = not KB, not O, not a fixed member

scores._source: plan sec.2 (D6 tau sweep; FLatS alpha grid); cosine top-10 mean (abs, S_tau, mix) and 10th-NN (absk, mixk)

metrics._source: analysis rev3 sec.5: d' primary (all pairs), G secondary on A_abs <= 0.98; operating point = threshold accepting 95% of the KB calibration queries; two-way (KB x O) bootstrap
metrics._dprime_clip_source: our choice (as P19): AUROC clipped to [1e-4, 1 - 1e-4] before Phi^-1

_a16_source: A16 (experiments/A16/PLAN.md; user '진행해' 2026-10-08): A1 rules unchanged on the Amazon build; distance = co-purchase profile JS (data/processed/A16/copurchase_js.csv), category = top-level node, SE category strata not applicable (ood_cat_keep = []); rank strata rescaled to the site count n: near 1-6 as A1, mid 7-round((n-1) * 30 / 85), far the rest; after the review rebuild n = 67: mid 7-23, far 24-66 (rule fixed before any A16 result). Review 2026-10-08 (user '수정해서 진행해'): KB / O neighbour band without the category condition (primary, nb_same_category = false); the A1 rule is the sensitivity config_a1_nbcat.json (results_nbcat).
